Priya: following up from the all-hands 14. drop 1-2 short bullets with concrete asks from the wins/losses discussion.
AllHandsBot: slides + recording: https://redwood.app/ah/2142007777 :white_check_mark:
Evan: leadership wants evidence-first assets this quarter: perf one-pagers, a compliance FAQ, and a migration smoke-test. please nominate owners.
Marco: Sales: we need a 48h RFP bundle we can attach. includes compliance FAQ and a deploy/test checklist. owner: Marco (SalesOps).
Hana: Product: will own perf one-pager template + sample export. owner: Hana (Product).
Nia: CS: will own migration smoke-test 1-pager and rollback expectations. owner: Nia (CS).
Sam: Legal: i willing to draft a redacted compliance appendix and the KMS/residency FAQ. owner: Sam (Legal).
Chris: Eng-runtime: will provide reproducible perf snapshots and a small perf harness. owner: Chris (Eng). note: need product to define canonical workloads.
Priya: thanks 14. i'll consolidate owners and delivery weeks and circulate a short roadmap doc by EOD. add any blockers or short links here.
